title: Oily Flaky Middle Eastern Lamb Flatbread
description: A briny and flaky Middle Eastern dish featuring lamb and sansho, perfect for a sick day, made with long fermentation dough and anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Combine flour, water, and yogurt in a bowl to make the dough, then knead for 10 minutes and let it rest for 24 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the dough into a large rectangle, about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread the ground lamb mixture, which includes sansho pepper, salt, and black pepper, evenly over the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Drizzle olive oil over the lamb mixture and sprinkle sumac on top.
Bake the flatbread in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the lamb is cooked through.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the flatbread hot, garnished with additional sumac and a side of yogurt sauce if desired.
